text_block_list.text:
We get right back to our regular training
after
summer camp. As part of that, we
decide to hold
a scrimmage.
So, who's my opponent for today?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Hiii, Hayahide! Are you as excited to
race as I
am?!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Ticket?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Wait, are you sure you want me to race
her? I
don't think revealing my strategies
right before
the Kikuka Sho is a good
idea.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list:
I arranged this because I have a feeling you're
not ready.

text_block_list.text:
Are you saying you know what's missing
from the
equation I've poured myself
into, then?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Sorry. I get it. This race is meant to help
me with
that.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: I'll get ready. And I'm not going to lose.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
The race between Уиннинг Тикит and
Biwa
Hayahide begins.

Things start getting interesting on the

straightaway, right after the fourth
corner...
Pant... pant...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
(I've pulled quite far ahead of Ticket.
Her sprint
speed is worrisome, but
according to our data, I
should be fine
with this big of a lead.)
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Ngh! RAAAH!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
(Is... Is she charging forward already?
That's fast!
But that speed's not
sustainable. She'll be out of
stamina in
200 meters!)
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
(I'm not going to let her reckless gambit
shake me
up, though. As long as I
maintain this pace and
sprint in the final
stretch...)
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: RAAAGGGHHH!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Wha?!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
(I'm still in the lead. Stay calm. Just 300
meters to
go. I can maintain this lead.
And once she runs
out of steam—)
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list: You need to go on the offensive, Hayahide.

text_block_list.text: Ngh, even if I wanted to—
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Hrrrngh... WAAAGH! I... WILL... WIN!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
(No way... How... How are you next to
me? Now
you're in front?)
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит overtakes Бива Хаяхидэ
and flies
across the finish line.
Huff... Wheeze... How?! How could I have...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list: Why didn't you go on offense?

text_block_list.text: Ngh...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Pheeew! That was a nice one! Wanna go
again? I
know how much it sucks to lose!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
But I like winning a lot too, so I won't
just give
you the victory!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: I think that's enough, wild child.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Whoa, Taishin!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Let her work at her own pace. If you still
have
energy left over, why don't you go
for a run with
me?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: But...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Come on, let's go! Later, Hayahide.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
After she finishes her cooldown, I hand
Biwa
Hayahide a drink.

Remember how you told me I needed to
go on
the offensive during the race?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: I finally figured it out.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
It's not that I didn't go on the offensive.
It's that I
was too busy playing defense.
That's the
difference between me and
them.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: I was trying not to lose.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Now that I think about it, I'm always
playing it
safe. They invariably say they
want to win, but I
only think about not
wanting to lose.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Even the winning equation I've been
working on
since I was young...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Wow! Brian is even faster than Hayahide!
text_block_list.name: Child

text_block_list.text:
She really is! Brian's so amazing. She
might
outshine her older sister!
text_block_list.name: Parent

text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... Don't count... me out! I'm gonna get... so much faster! I'll be.. the fastest anyone's ever seen!
text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide

text_block_list.text:
I'll be fast enough... to beat Brian one
day!
text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide

text_block_list.text: Crash!
Sis?!
text_block_list.name: Young Brian

text_block_list.text: I... I lost again... Sniffle...
text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide

text_block_list.text:
I'll win next time! I'll come up with an
equation to
win so I'll never lose to
anyone! Especially not
her...
text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide

text_block_list.text:
The whole reason I started working on
my winning
equation was because I
didn't want to lose.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Ironic, isn't it?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
It's no wonder Ticket and Taishin always
exceed
the parameters of my little
calculations. Of course
they do.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: They're always on the offensive—willing to do whatever it takes for a chance at victory because they're trying to win.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Their way of thinking differs from mine
on a
fundamental level. There's simply
no way my
equation can compete with
them.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
How stupid of me to call it a "winning
equation"
when all I've been doing is
calculating how not to
lose!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Why did it take me so long to figure it
out?
What's the point anymore?!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list:
Mistakes are learning opportunities. You can fix
it now that you've realized what's wrong.

text_block_list.text:
If Бива Хаяхидэ was the type of
Umamusume to
throw away her dreams
over something like this...

Then she would have given up a long
time ago
when she got hurt trying to
catch up to her sister.

That might be true, but we'll have to
start over
from square one.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I established the equation on the wrong
basis,
and now I have to scrap it and
rebuild everything
from scratch.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
There's not much time until the Kikuka
Sho. If we
do this, it's going to take up a
lot of your time
too.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list: You want to win the Kikuka Sho, right?

text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list: If so, I'm here to help.

text_block_list.text: You're... You're an idiot...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
But I'm an even bigger idiot, which is
why I'm
accepting your offer.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
We resume training immediately to
reformulate
her winning equation.
Ah! Hayahide, you really came!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Ticket? What are you doing here?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Taishin said you were sure to show
up if we
waited! Right, Taishin?
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Maybe you were waiting. I was letting you take a break so we could go for a run.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Taishin! You're such a meanie!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Whatever.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna go for a run. Join us if you
want. Or
don't.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: Are you two here to cheer Hayahide up?

text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Yeah! We might be rivals, but
we're friends
first and foremost!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
You know you can always talk to us if
you've got
something on your mind,
right, Hayahide?
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I do... It seems I've been too
narrow-minded. I'll
need to do
something about that.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ jogs toward the track
after her
friends.
